SND_EN_PP1_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL1 bt
Left OUTER JOIN
snd_pr_geo_geog_hierarchy gh
    ON gh.porg_orgacode = bt.porg_orgacode AND gh.pgeo_geoghier_code = bt.pgeo_geoghier_code
  LEFT JOIN snd_pr_geo_geog_hierarchy_m ghl
    ON ghl.porg_orgacode = gh.porg_orgacode AND ghl.pgeo_geoghier_code = gh.pgeo_geoghier_code AND
       ghl.plng_langcode =  '@Session(languageCode)'
Left OUTER JOIN GLB_PR_LOC_LOCATION PLOC ON
PLOC.PORG_ORGACODE = bt.PORG_ORGACODE AND
PLOC.ploc_locacode = bt.ploc_locacode
         LEFT JOIN GLB_PR_LOC_LOCATION_M PLOCM ON PLOC.PORG_ORGACODE = PLOCM.PORG_ORGACODE
    AND PLOC.PLOC_LOCACODE = PLOCM.PLOC_LOCACODE AND PLOCM.PLNG_LANGCODE = '@Session(languageCode)'

                            BT.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = ML.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE AND BT.PORG_ORGACODE = ML.PORG_ORGACODE AND
                            ML.PLNG_LANGCODE = '@Session(languageCode)'

                                                         BMM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'

SND_EN_PP1_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL1 bt
Left OUTER JOIN
snd_pr_geo_geog_hierarchy gh
    ON gh.porg_orgacode = bt.porg_orgacode AND gh.pgeo_geoghier_code = bt.pgeo_geoghier_code
  LEFT JOIN snd_pr_geo_geog_hierarchy_m ghl
    ON ghl.porg_orgacode = gh.porg_orgacode AND ghl.pgeo_geoghier_code = gh.pgeo_geoghier_code AND
       ghl.plng_langcode =  '@Session(languageCode)'
Left OUTER JOIN GLB_PR_LOC_LOCATION PLOC ON
PLOC.PORG_ORGACODE = bt.PORG_ORGACODE AND
PLOC.ploc_locacode = bt.ploc_locacode
         LEFT JOIN GLB_PR_LOC_LOCATION_M PLOCM ON PLOC.PORG_ORGACODE = PLOCM.PORG_ORGACODE

        floor(case query.sellFactor2
                  when 0 then 0
                  else (query.ClosingBalanceInPCS - (floor(case query.sellFactor1
                                                               when 0 then 0
                                                               else query.ClosingBalanceInPCS / query.sellFactor1 end) *
                                                     query.sellFactor1)) / query.sellFactor2 end)          ATP_DZN,
        ClosingBalanceInPCS -
        (floor(case query.sellFactor1 when 0 then 0 else query.ClosingBalanceInPCS / query.sellFactor1 end) *
         query.sellFactor1) - (floor(case query.sellFactor2
                                         when 0 then 0
                                         else (query.ClosingBalanceInPCS - (floor(case query.sellFactor1
                                                                                      when 0 then 0
                                                                                      else query.ClosingBalanceInPCS / query.sellFactor1 end) *
                                                                            query.sellFactor1)) /
                                              query.sellFactor2 end) * query.sellFactor2)                  ATP_PCS,
        floor(case query.sellFactor1
                  when 0 then 0
                  else query.ClosingBalanceInPCSWOA / query.sellFactor1 end)                               ClosingBalanceCTN,
        floor(case query.sellFactor2
                  when 0 then 0
                  else (query.ClosingBalanceInPCSWOA - (floor(case query.sellFactor1
                                                                  when 0 then 0
                                                                  else query.ClosingBalanceInPCSWOA / query.sellFactor1 end) *

        ClosingBalanceInPCSWOA -
        (floor(case query.sellFactor1 when 0 then 0 else query.ClosingBalanceInPCSWOA / query.sellFactor1 end) *
         query.sellFactor1) - (floor(case query.sellFactor2
                                         when 0 then 0
                                         else (query.ClosingBalanceInPCSWOA - (floor(case query.sellFactor1
                                                                                         when 0 then 0
                                                                                         else query.ClosingBalanceInPCSWOA / query.sellFactor1 end) *
                                                                               query.sellFactor1)) /
                                              query.sellFactor2 end) *
                               query.sellFactor2)                                                          ClosingBalancePCS,


        TXT__porg_orgacode,
        DDL__pptp_period_type,
        TXT__porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_b,
        TXT__pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_b,
        epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
        warehousedesc,
        query.PORG_ORGACODE,
        pptp_period_type,
        tssb_balance_date,
        TXT__ppa1prodanalysis3,
        TXT__ppa1prodanalysis4,
        TXT__STOCKTYPEDESC,
        pgpp_price_code,
        query.pdpp_purchase_price_pcs,
        MODIFIED_DATE,
        TXT__MOVING_AVG_PRICE,

                (floor(case query.sellFactor1
                  when 0 then 0
                  else query.ClosingBalanceInPCSWOA / query.sellFactor1 end) * query.sellFactor1+
        floor(case query.sellFactor2
                  when 0 then 0
                  else (query.ClosingBalanceInPCSWOA - (floor(case query.sellFactor1
                                                                  when 0 then 0
                                                                  else query.ClosingBalanceInPCSWOA / query.sellFactor1 end) *
                                                        query.sellFactor1)) /
                       query.sellFactor2 end)  *query.sellFactor2 +
        ClosingBalanceInPCSWOA -
        (floor(case query.sellFactor1 when 0 then 0 else query.ClosingBalanceInPCSWOA / query.sellFactor1 end) *
         query.sellFactor1) - (floor(case query.sellFactor2
                                         when 0 then 0
                                         else (query.ClosingBalanceInPCSWOA - (floor(case query.sellFactor1
                                                                                         when 0 then 0
                                                                                         else query.ClosingBalanceInPCSWOA / query.sellFactor1 end) *
                                                                               query.sellFactor1)) /
                                              query.sellFactor2 end) *
                               query.sellFactor2)    * query.sellFactor3)  * TXT__MOVING_AVG_PRICE as TXT__CLOSING_STOCK_VALUE

                                                                   , ((TXT__tssb_qty_1* query.sellFactor1)+(TXT__tssb_qty_2*query.sellFactor2)+ (TXT__tssb_qty_3* query.sellFactor3)) * TXT__MOVING_AVG_PRICE as TXT__OPENING_STOCK_VALUE

              (coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_reserved_3, 0) * coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_3, 0)) as ClosingBalanceInPCS,
              (coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_1, 0) * coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_1, 0)) +

              (coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_c_1, 0) * coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_1, 0)) +

              (coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_b_2, 0) * coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_2, 0)) -
              (coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_c_2, 0) * coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_2, 0)) +

              (coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_c_3, 0) * coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_3, 0))        as ClosingBalanceInPCSWOA,
              coalesce(BTH.pbth_uom_factor_1, 0)                                           as sellFactor1,

                       sum(DA_IN3)                                                          DA_IN3,
                       max(TXT__MOVING_AVG_PRICE) as TXT__MOVING_AVG_PRICE,
                       max(TXT__CLOSING_STOCK_VALUE) as TXT__CLOSING_STOCK_VALUE
                from (
                         select TRSB.porg_orgacode,
                                TRSB.pbet_busentity_type,
                                TRSB.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
                                TRSB.pstt_stock_type,
                                TRSB.tssb_srno,
                                TRSB.porp_princode,
                                TRSB.pprd_prodcode,
                                TRSB.pbth_batch,
                                TRSB.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_b,
                                TRSB.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_b,
                                TRSB.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_b,


                                coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_1, 0)          tssb_qty_1,
                                coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_2, 0)          tssb_qty_2,
                                coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_3, 0)          tssb_qty_3,
                                coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_b_1, 0)        tssb_qty_b_1,
                                coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_b_2, 0)        tssb_qty_b_2,
                                coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_b_3, 0)        tssb_qty_b_3,
                                coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_b_3, 0)        tssb_qty_b_4,
                                coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_b_2, 0)        tssb_qty_b_5,
                                coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_c_1, 0)        tssb_qty_c_1,
                                coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_c_2, 0)        tssb_qty_c_2,
                                coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_c_3, 0)        tssb_qty_c_3,
                                coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_reserved_1, 0) tssb_qty_reserved_1,
                                coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_reserved_2, 0) tssb_qty_reserved_2,
                                coalesce(TRSB.tssb_qty_reserved_3, 0) tssb_qty_reserved_3,

                                0                                     DA_IN1,
                                0                                     DA_IN2,
                                0                                     DA_IN3,
                                coalesce(TRSB.TSSB_MOVING_AVG_PRICE, 0)    AS TXT__MOVING_AVG_PRICE,
                                0 as TXT__CLOSING_STOCK_VALUE
                         from snd_tr_ssb_salestock_balance TRSB
                         where TRSB.PORG_ORGACODE = '@Session(OrgaCode)'
                           and TRSB.pbet_busentity_type = 'DIST'
                           and TRSB.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = '@Session(DIST)'
                           and TRSB.pptp_period_type = '@Model(DDL__pptp_period_type)'
                           and TRSB.tssb_balance_type = 'CL'
                           and TRSB.tssb_period_year =
                               TO_CHAR(cast('@Model(DDT__tssb_balance_dateChild)' as DATE), 'YYYY')
                           and TRSB.tssb_balance_date = cast('@Model(DDT__tssb_balance_dateChild)' as DATE)
                         union all

                         select stssd.porg_orgacode,
                                stssd.pbet_busentity_type,
                                stssd.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
                                stssd.pstt_stock_type,
                                -99             tssb_srno,
                                stssd.porp_princode,
                                stssd.pprd_prodcode,
                                stssd.pbth_batch,
                                stssm.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_b,
                                stssm.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_b,
                                stssm.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_b,
                                0               tssb_qty_1,
                                0               tssb_qty_2,
                                0               tssb_qty_3,
                                0               tssb_qty_b_1,
                                0               tssb_qty_b_2,
                                0               tssb_qty_b_3,
                                0               tssb_qty_b_4,
                                0               tssb_qty_b_5,
                                0               tssb_qty_c_1,
                                0               tssb_qty_c_2,
                                0               tssb_qty_c_3,
                                0               tssb_qty_reserved_1,
                                0               tssb_qty_reserved_2,
                                0               tssb_qty_reserved_3,

                                sum(tstd_qty_1) DA_IN1,
                                sum(tstd_qty_2) DA_IN2,
                                sum(tstd_qty_3) DA_IN3, 0 as TXT__MOVING_AVG_PRICE,
                                0 as TXT__CLOSING_STOCK_VALUE
                         from snd_tr_stm_stock_master stssm
                                  inner join snd_tr_stm_stock_detail stssd
                                             on stssd.porg_orgacode = stssm.porg_orgacode and
                                                stssd.pbet_busentity_type = stssm.pbet_busentity_type and
                                                stssd.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = stssm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code and
                                                stssd.pdot_docmtype = stssm.pdot_docmtype and
                                                stssd.tstm_docno = stssm.tstm_docno
                                  left join glb_pr_ogl_org_globalization x
                                            on x.porg_orgacode = stssd.porg_orgacode and x.pogl_desc = 'TIMEZONE'
                                  inner join snd_pr_dot_documenttype spdd
                                             on stssm.porg_orgacode = spdd.porg_orgacode and
                                                stssm.pdot_docmtype = spdd.pdot_docmtype and
                                                stssm.tstm_status = 'I' and pdot_nature_identifier in ('DAA', 'DA')
                         group by stssd.porg_orgacode, stssd.pbet_busentity_type,
                                  stssd.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code, stssd.pstt_stock_type, stssd.porp_princode,
                                  stssd.pprd_prodcode, stssd.pbth_batch, stssm.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_b,
                                  stssm.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_b, stssm.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_b
                     ) x
                group by x.porg_orgacode, x.pbet_busentity_type,
                         x.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
                         x.pstt_stock_type,
                         x.porp_princode,
                         x.pprd_prodcode,
                         x.pbth_batch,
                         x.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_b,
                         x.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_b,
                         x.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_b
            ) TRSB
                inner join snd_pr_prd_product PRD
                           on TRSB.porg_orgacode = PRD.porg_orgacode and TRSB.porp_princode = PRD.porp_princode and
                              TRSB.pprd_prodcode = PRD.pprd_prodcode and
                              TRSB.PORG_ORGACODE = '@Session(OrgaCode)' and TRSB.pbet_busentity_type = 'DIST' and
                              TRSB.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = '@Session(DIST)' and
                              TRSB.pptp_period_type = '@Model(DDL__pptp_period_type)' and
                              TRSB.tssb_balance_type = 'CL' and TRSB.tssb_period_year =
                                                                TO_CHAR(cast('@Model(DDT__tssb_balance_dateChild)' as DATE), 'YYYY') and
                              TRSB.tssb_balance_date = cast('@Model(DDT__tssb_balance_dateChild)' as DATE)
                left join snd_pr_prd_product_m prdm
                           on prd.porg_orgacode = prdm.porg_orgacode and prd.porp_princode = prdm.porp_princode and
                              prd.pprd_prodcode = prdm.pprd_prodcode and
                              prdm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
                left join snd_pr_prd_product_m prdms
                           on prd.porg_orgacode = prdms.porg_orgacode and prd.porp_princode = prdms.porp_princode and
                              prd.pprd_prodcode = prdms.pprd_prodcode and prdms.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCodeSecondary)'

                inner join snd_pr_bth_prod_batch BTH
                           on bth.porg_orgacode = TRSB.porg_orgacode and bth.porp_princode = trsb.porp_princode and
                              bth.pprd_prodcode = trsb.pprd_prodcode and bth.pbth_batch = trsb.pbth_batch
                inner join snd_pr_dpp_dist_prch_price price
                           on price.porg_orgacode = BTH.porg_orgacode and price.pbet_busentity_type = 'DIST' and
                              price.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = '@Session(DIST)' and
                              price.porp_princode = BTH.porp_princode and
                              price.pprd_prodcode = BTH.pprd_prodcode and
                              price.pdpp_price_code = BTH.pgpp_price_code
                inner join snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1 pp1
                           on pp1.porg_orgacode = TRSB.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_b and
                              pp1.pbet_busentity_type = TRSB.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_b and
                              pp1.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = TRSB.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_b
                left join snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1_m pp1m
                           on pp1m.porg_orgacode = TRSB.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_b and
                              pp1m.pbet_busentity_type = TRSB.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_b and
                              pp1m.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = TRSB.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_b and
                              pp1m.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
                inner join snd_pr_stt_sku_stocktype ST
                           on ST.porg_orgacode = TRSB.porg_orgacode and ST.pstt_stock_type = TRSB.pstt_stock_type
                left join snd_pr_stt_sku_stocktype_m STM
                          on ST.porg_orgacode = STM.porg_orgacode and ST.pstt_stock_type = STM.pstt_stock_type and
                             STM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
                left outer join snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1 A3 on A3.porg_orgacode = PRD.porg_orgacode and
                                                                 A3.ppa1_prod_analysis =
                                                                 left(PRD.ppa1_prod_analysis,
                                                                      (select length(min(p3.ppa1_prod_analysis))
                                                                       from snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1 p3
                                                                       where p3.porg_orgacode = '@Session(OrgaCode)'
                                                                         and p3.ppa1_level_no = 3)) and
                                                                 A3.ppa1_level_no = 3
                left outer join snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1 A5 on A5.porg_orgacode = PRD.porg_orgacode and
                                                                 A5.ppa1_prod_analysis =
                                                                 left(PRD.ppa1_prod_analysis,
                                                                      (select length(min(p5.ppa1_prod_analysis))
                                                                       from snd_pr_pa1_prod_analysis_1 p5
                                                                       WHERE p5.porg_orgacode = '@Session(OrgaCode)'
                                                                         and p5.ppa1_level_no = 5)) and
                                                                 A5.ppa1_level_no = 5) query)

result.tbl:
(select cmm.tcmm_docno,
        cmm.pdot_docmtype,
        coalesce(pdotm.pdot_desc, pdot.pdot_desc)                     pdot_desc,
        coalesce(DOSM.pdos_desc, DOS.pdos_desc)                       DOCUMENT_STATUS,
        cmm.PEXS_EXECUTION_STATUS,
        ES.PEXS_DESC,
        coalesce(pp1m.epp1_desc, pp1.epp1_desc)                       epp1_descx,
        cmm.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c                            AS Outlet_Code,
        coalesce(pp1mu.epp1_desc, pp1u.epp1_desc)                     epp1_descy,
        CMM.EPJP_PJPNO_DAILY                                       AS PJP_NO,
        coalesce(pp1dsrm.epp2_desc, pp1dsr.epp2_desc)                 epp2_desc_OB,
        coalesce(pp1DSRm_DM.epp2_desc, pp1DSR_DM.epp2_desc)           epp2_desc_DM,
        CMM.EPJP_PJPNO_DAILY || ' / ' || epjp_pjpno_daily_delivery AS PJP_ORDBKR_DELMAN,
        coalesce(pp1dsrm.epp2_desc, pp1dsr.epp2_desc) || ' ' || '/' || ' ' ||
        coalesce(pp1DSRm_DM.epp2_desc, pp1DSR_DM.epp2_desc)        as ORDBKR_DELMAN,
        cmm.epl1_busent_code_log_lvl1_l                            AS SECTION_CODE,
        coalesce(SECTM.epl1_desc, SECT.epl1_desc)                  as SECTION_NAME,
        coalesce(pp1mu.epp1_abrv, pp1u.epp1_abrv)                     epp1_abrvy,
        cmm.pcur_currcode,
        cmm.tcmm_docm_date                                            tcmm_docm_fromdate,
        cmm.tcmm_docm_date                                            tcmm_docm_todate,
        cmm.tcmm_delivery_date,
        cmm.porg_orgacode,
        coalesce(cmd.gross_amt_fcy, 0)                                gross_amt_fcy,
        coalesce(charg.tcmc_value, 0)                                 tax_amt_fcy,
        coalesce(disc.discAmt, 0)                                     dsc_amt_fcy,
        coalesce(CMM.tcmm_received_amt_fcy, 0)                     AS RECEIVED_AMT_FCY,
        cmm.tcmm_net_amt_fcy                                          net_amount,
        cmm.pbet_busentity_type,
        cmm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
        cmt.pcmt_cashmemo_type,
        coalesce(cmtm.pcmt_desc, cmt.pcmt_desc)                       cashmemoTypeDesc,
        cmm.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_c,
        cmm.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_c,
        cmm.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c,
        cmm.tcmm_ref_docno,
        cmm.tcmm_ref_no,
        GNM.tcmr_refdocno                                          AS GIN_NO,
        CMM.MODIFIED_DATE                                          AS MODIFIED_DATE
 from snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_master cmm
          inner join (select sum(coalesce(cmd.tcmd_grs_amt_fcy, 0)) gross_amt_fcy,
                             cmd.porg_orgacode,
                             cmd.pbet_busentity_type,
                             cmd.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
                             cmd.pdot_docmtype,
                             cmd.tcmm_docno
                      from snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_detail cmd
                      group by cmd.porg_orgacode, cmd.pbet_busentity_type,
                               cmd.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
                               cmd.pdot_docmtype, cmd.tcmm_docno) cmd
                     on cmm.porg_orgacode = cmd.porg_orgacode and
                        cmm.pbet_busentity_type = cmd.pbet_busentity_type and
                        cmm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = cmd.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code and
                        cmm.pdot_docmtype = cmd.pdot_docmtype and cmm.tcmm_docno = cmd.tcmm_docno
          left join (select sum(coalesce(tcmc_value, 0)) tcmc_value,
                            porg_orgacode,
                            pbet_busentity_type,
                            epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
                            pdot_docmtype,
                            tcmm_docno
                     from snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_charges charg
                     group by porg_orgacode, pbet_busentity_type, epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
                              pdot_docmtype,
                              tcmm_docno) charg on charg.porg_orgacode = cmm.porg_orgacode and
                                                   charg.pbet_busentity_type = cmm.pbet_busentity_type and
                                                   charg.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = cmm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code and
                                                   charg.pdot_docmtype = cmm.pdot_docmtype and
                                                   charg.tcmm_docno = cmm.tcmm_docno
          inner join snd_pr_dot_documenttype pdot
                     on cmm.porg_orgacode = pdot.porg_orgacode and
                        cmm.pdot_docmtype = pdot.pdot_docmtype
          left join snd_pr_dot_documenttype_m pdotm
                    on pdot.porg_orgacode = pdotm.porg_orgacode and
                       pdot.pdot_docmtype = pdotm.pdot_docmtype and
                       pdotm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
          left join SND_PR_DOS_DOCUMENTSTATUS DOS
                    on cmm.porg_orgacode = DOS.porg_orgacode and
                       cmm.pdot_docmtype = DOS.pdot_docmtype and
                       cmm.pdos_docmstatus = DOS.pdos_docmstatus
          left join SND_PR_DOS_DOCUMENTSTATUS_M DOSM
                    on cmm.porg_orgacode = DOSM.porg_orgacode and
                       cmm.pdot_docmtype = DOSM.pdot_docmtype AND
                       cmm.pdos_docmstatus = DOSM.pdos_docmstatus AND
                       DOSM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
          left join glb_pr_exs_execution_status ES
                    on ES.porg_orgacode = cmm.porg_orgacode and
                       ES.pdot_docmtype = cmm.pdot_docmtype and
                       ES.PEXS_EXECUTION_STATUS = cmm.PEXS_EXECUTION_STATUS
          left join glb_pr_cmt_cashmemo_type cmt
                    on cmm.porg_orgacode = cmt.porg_orgacode and
                       cmm.pcmt_cashmemo_type = cmt.pcmt_cashmemo_type
          left join glb_pr_cmt_cashmemo_type_m cmtm
                    on cmt.porg_orgacode = cmtm.porg_orgacode and
                       cmt.pcmt_cashmemo_type = cmtm.pcmt_cashmemo_type and
                       cmtm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
          inner join snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1 pp1
                     on cmm.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_a = pp1.porg_orgacode and
                        cmm.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_a = pp1.pbet_busentity_type and
                        cmm.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_a = pp1.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
          left join snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1_m pp1m
                    on pp1.porg_orgacode = pp1m.porg_orgacode and
                       pp1.pbet_busentity_type = pp1m.pbet_busentity_type and
                       pp1.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = pp1m.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code and
                       pp1m.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
          inner join snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1 pp1U
                     on cmm.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_c = pp1u.porg_orgacode and
                        cmm.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_c = pp1u.pbet_busentity_type and
                        cmm.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c = pp1u.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
          left join snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1_m pp1mU
                    on pp1u.porg_orgacode = pp1mu.porg_orgacode and
                       pp1u.pbet_busentity_type = pp1mu.pbet_busentity_type and
                       pp1u.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = pp1mu.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code and
                       pp1mu.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
          inner join snd_en_pp2_prf_bsen_phs_lvl2 pp1DSR
                     on cmm.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl2_f = pp1dsr.porg_orgacode and
                        cmm.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl2_f = pp1dsr.pbet_busentity_type and
                        cmm.epp2_busent_code_phs_lvl2_f = pp1dsr.epp2_busent_phs_lvl2_code
          left join snd_en_pp2_prf_bsen_phs_lvl2_m pp1DSRm
                    on pp1dsr.porg_orgacode = pp1dsrm.porg_orgacode and
                       pp1dsr.pbet_busentity_type = pp1dsrm.pbet_busentity_type and
                       pp1dsr.epp2_busent_phs_lvl2_code = pp1dsrm.epp2_busent_phs_lvl2_code and
                       pp1dsrm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
          inner join snd_en_pp2_prf_bsen_phs_lvl2 pp1DSR_DM
                     on cmm.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl2_h = pp1DSR_DM.porg_orgacode and
                        cmm.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl2_h = pp1DSR_DM.pbet_busentity_type and
                        cmm.epp2_busent_code_phs_lvl2_h = pp1DSR_DM.epp2_busent_phs_lvl2_code
          left join snd_en_pp2_prf_bsen_phs_lvl2_m pp1DSRm_DM
                    on pp1DSR_DM.porg_orgacode = pp1DSRm_DM.porg_orgacode and
                       pp1DSR_DM.pbet_busentity_type = pp1DSRm_DM.pbet_busentity_type and
                       pp1DSR_DM.epp2_busent_phs_lvl2_code =
                       pp1DSRm_DM.epp2_busent_phs_lvl2_code and
                       pp1DSRm_DM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
          left outer join (select sum(coalesce(disc.tcmo_dsc_amt_fcy, 0)) discAmt,
                                  disc.porg_orgacode,
                                  disc.pbet_busentity_type,
                                  disc.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
                                  disc.pdot_docmtype,
                                  disc.tcmm_docno
                           from snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_offering disc
                                    inner join snd_pr_trn_trans_nature natr
                                               on disc.porg_orgacode = natr.porg_orgacode and
                                                  disc.ptrn_tran_nature = natr.ptrn_tran_nature and
                                                  natr.ptrn_nature = 'DIS'
                           group by disc.porg_orgacode, disc.pbet_busentity_type,
                                    disc.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
                                    disc.pdot_docmtype, disc.tcmm_docno) disc
                          on disc.porg_orgacode = cmm.porg_orgacode and
                             disc.pbet_busentity_type = cmm.pbet_busentity_type and
                             disc.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = cmm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code and
                             disc.pdot_docmtype = cmm.pdot_docmtype and
                             disc.tcmm_docno = cmm.tcmm_docno
          LEFT JOIN snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_refinfo GNM
                    ON cmm.PORG_ORGACODE = GNM.PORG_ORGACODE
                        AND cmm.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = GNM.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE
                        AND cmm.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE = GNM.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE
                        AND cmm.PDOT_DOCMTYPE = GNM.PDOT_DOCMTYPE
                        AND cmm.TCMM_DOCNO = GNM.TCMM_DOCNO AND GNM.tcmr_refdoctype = 'GN-01' and GNM. tcmr_status='1'

          LEFT join snd_en_pl1_prf_bsen_log_lvl1 SECT
                    on cmm.porg_orgacode_log_lvl1_l = SECT.porg_orgacode and
                       cmm.pbet_busent_type_log_lvl1_l = SECT.pbet_busentity_type and
                       cmm.epl1_busent_code_log_lvl1_l = SECT.epl1_busent_log_lvl1_code
          left join snd_en_pl1_prf_bsen_log_lvl1_M SECTM
                    on SECT.porg_orgacode = SECTM.porg_orgacode and
                       SECT.pbet_busentity_type = SECTM.pbet_busentity_type and
                       SECT.epl1_busent_log_lvl1_code = SECTM.epl1_busent_log_lvl1_code and
                       SECTM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
)

result.tbl:
SND_TR_CMM_CASHMEMO_DETAIL cd
         INNER JOIN snd_pr_prd_product prd
                    ON cd.porg_orgacode = prd.porg_orgacode AND cd.porp_princode = prd.porp_princode AND
                       cd.pprd_prodcode = prd.pprd_prodcode
         LEFT JOIN snd_pr_prd_product_m prdm
                   ON prd.porg_orgacode = prdm.porg_orgacode AND prd.porp_princode = prdm.porp_princode AND
                      prd.pprd_prodcode = prdm.pprd_prodcode AND prdm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
             LEFT JOIN snd_pr_prd_product_m prdms
                   ON prd.porg_orgacode = prdms.porg_orgacode AND prd.porp_princode = prdms.porp_princode AND
                      prd.pprd_prodcode = prdms.pprd_prodcode AND prdms.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCodeSecondary)'
         INNER JOIN snd_pr_stt_sku_stocktype st
                    ON cd.porg_orgacode = st.porg_orgacode AND cd.pstt_stock_type = st.pstt_stock_type
         LEFT JOIN snd_pr_stt_sku_stocktype_m stm
                   ON st.porg_orgacode = stm.porg_orgacode AND st.pstt_stock_type = stm.pstt_stock_type AND
                      stm.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         inner join snd_pr_bth_prod_batch bat
                    ON bat.porg_orgacode = cd.porg_orgacode AND bat.porp_princode = cd.porp_princode AND
                       bat.pprd_prodcode = cd.pprd_prodcode and bat.pbth_batch = cd.pbth_batch
         LEFT JOIN GLB_PR_RNT_REASON_TYPE RNT
                   ON RNT.PORG_ORGACODE = CD.PORG_ORGACODE
                       AND RNT.PRNT_REASON_TYPE = CD.PRNT_REASON_TYPE_SALE_RETURN
         LEFT JOIN GLB_PR_RNT_REASON_TYPE_M RNTM
                   ON RNT.PORG_ORGACODE = RNTM.PORG_ORGACODE
                       AND RNT.PRNT_REASON_TYPE = RNTM.PRNT_REASON_TYPE
                       AND RNTM.PLNG_LANGCODE = '@Session(languageCode)'

SND_TR_CMM_CASHMEMO_OFFRITEM CFI
         inner join snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_offering offr
                    on cfi.porg_orgacode = offr.porg_orgacode and cfi.pbet_busentity_type = offr.pbet_busentity_type and
                       cfi.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = offr.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code and
                       cfi.pdot_docmtype = offr.pdot_docmtype and cfi.tcmm_docno = offr.tcmm_docno and
                       cfi.tcmo_offer_srno = offr.tcmo_offer_srno
         INNER JOIN SND_TR_CMM_CASHMEMO_DETAIL CMD
                    ON CMD.porg_orgacode = CFI.porg_orgacode AND CMD.pbet_busentity_type = CFI.pbet_busentity_type AND
                       CMD.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = CFI.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code AND
                       CMD.pdot_docmtype = CFI.pdot_docmtype AND CMD.tcmm_docno = CFI.tcmm_docno AND
                       CMD.porp_princode = CFI.porp_princode AND CMD.pprd_prodcode = CFI.pprd_prodcode AND
                       CMD.pbth_batch = CFI.pbth_batch
         inner join prm_pm_pms_promotion_setup prmtype
                    on offr.porg_orgacode = prmtype.porg_orgacode and offr.psch_schme_id = prmtype.ppms_promotion_code
         left join prm_pm_pms_promotion_setup_m prmtypem on prmtype.porg_orgacode = prmtypem.porg_orgacode and
                                                            prmtype.ppms_promotion_code = prmtypem.ppms_promotion_code and
                                                            prmtypem.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         INNER JOIN snd_pr_prd_product PRD
                    ON CFI.porg_orgacode = PRD.porg_orgacode AND CFI.porp_princode = PRD.porp_princode AND
                       CFI.pprd_prodcode = PRD.pprd_prodcode
         LEFT JOIN snd_pr_prd_product_m PRDM

SND_TR_CMM_CASHMEMO_OFFRITEM CFI
         INNER JOIN SND_TR_CMM_CASHMEMO_OFFERING OFFR
                    ON CFI.PORG_ORGACODE = OFFR.PORG_ORGACODE
                        AND CFI.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = OFFR.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE
                        AND CFI.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE = OFFR.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE
                        AND CFI.PDOT_DOCMTYPE = OFFR.PDOT_DOCMTYPE
                        AND CFI.TCMM_DOCNO = OFFR.TCMM_DOCNO
                        AND CFI.TCMO_OFFER_SRNO = OFFR.TCMO_OFFER_SRNO

         INNER JOIN PRM_PM_PMS_PROMOTION_SETUP PRMTYPE
                   ON OFFR.PORG_ORGACODE = PRMTYPE.PORG_ORGACODE
                       AND OFFR.PSCH_SCHME_ID = PRMTYPE.PPMS_PROMOTION_CODE

         LEFT JOIN PRM_PM_PMS_PROMOTION_SETUP_M PRMTYPEM
                   ON PRMTYPE.PORG_ORGACODE = PRMTYPEM.PORG_ORGACODE
                       AND PRMTYPE.PPMS_PROMOTION_CODE = PRMTYPEM.PPMS_PROMOTION_CODE
                       AND PRMTYPEM.PLNG_LANGCODE = '@Session(languageCode)'

         INNER JOIN SND_PR_PRD_PRODUCT PRD
                    ON CFI.PORG_ORGACODE = PRD.PORG_ORGACODE
                        AND CFI.PORP_PRINCODE = PRD.PORP_PRINCODE
                        AND CFI.PPRD_PRODCODE = PRD.PPRD_PRODCODE

         LEFT JOIN SND_PR_PRD_PRODUCT_M PRDM
                   ON PRD.PORG_ORGACODE = PRDM.PORG_ORGACODE
                       AND PRD.PORP_PRINCODE = PRDM.PORP_PRINCODE
                       AND PRD.PPRD_PRODCODE = PRDM.PPRD_PRODCODE
                       AND PRDM.PLNG_LANGCODE = '@Session(languageCode)'

         LEFT JOIN SND_PR_PRD_PRODUCT_M PRDMS
                   ON PRD.PORG_ORGACODE = PRDMS.PORG_ORGACODE
                       AND PRD.PORP_PRINCODE = PRDMS.PORP_PRINCODE
                       AND PRD.PPRD_PRODCODE = PRDMS.PPRD_PRODCODE
                       AND PRDMS.PLNG_LANGCODE = '@Session(languageCodeSecondary)'

         INNER JOIN SND_PR_TRN_TRANS_NATURE NAT
                    ON CFI.PORG_ORGACODE = NAT.PORG_ORGACODE
                        AND CFI.PTRN_TRAN_NATURE = NAT.PTRN_TRAN_NATURE
                        AND NAT.PTRN_NATURE = 'FRE'

         LEFT JOIN SND_PR_BTH_PROD_BATCH BTH
                    ON CFI.PORG_ORGACODE = BTH.PORG_ORGACODE
                        AND CFI.PORP_PRINCODE = BTH.PORP_PRINCODE
                        AND CFI.PPRD_PRODCODE = BTH.PPRD_PRODCODE
                        AND CFI.PBTH_BATCH = BTH.PBTH_BATCH

         LEFT JOIN SND_PR_STT_SKU_STOCKTYPE STT
                        ON CFI.PORG_ORGACODE = STT.PORG_ORGACODE
                        AND CFI.PSTT_STOCK_TYPE = STT.PSTT_STOCK_TYPE

         LEFT JOIN SND_PR_STT_SKU_STOCKTYPE_M STTM
                        ON STT.PORG_ORGACODE = STTM.PORG_ORGACODE
                        AND STT.PSTT_STOCK_TYPE = STTM.PSTT_STOCK_TYPE
                        AND STTM.PLNG_LANGCODE = '@Session(languageCode)'

(SELECT CFI.psch_schme_id,
             PPS.PPMS_DESC,
             CFI.tcmo_promotion_type,
             CFI.PORG_ORGACODE,
             CFI.pbet_busentity_type,
             CFI.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
             CFI.PDOT_DOCMTYPE,
             CFI.TCMM_DOCNO,
             SUM((coalesce(ofitm.TCMI_QTY_1, 0) * coalesce(bth.pbth_uom_factor_1, 0)) +
             (coalesce(ofitm.TCMI_QTY_2, 0) * coalesce(bth.pbth_uom_factor_2, 0)) +
             (coalesce(ofitm.TCMI_QTY_3, 0) * coalesce(bth.pbth_uom_factor_3, 0))) as freeQty,
             SUM(coalesce(ofitm.tcmi_dsc_amt_fcy, 0))                               AS TCMO_DSC_AMT_FCY,
             SUM(coalesce(ofitm.tcmi_tax_amt_fcy, 0))                               AS TCMO_TAX_AMT_FCY,
             SUM((coalesce(ofitm.TCMI_QTY_B_1, 0) * coalesce(bth.pbth_uom_factor_1, 0)) +
             (coalesce(ofitm.TCMI_QTY_B_2, 0) * coalesce(bth.pbth_uom_factor_2, 0)) +
             (coalesce(ofitm.TCMI_QTY_B_3, 0) * coalesce(bth.pbth_uom_factor_3, 0))) as allocatedQty,
             CFI.MODIFIED_DATE                                                      AS MODIFIED_DATE
      FROM snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_offering CFI
               INNER JOIN prm_pm_pms_promotion_setup PPS
                          ON CFI.porg_orgacode = PPS.porg_orgacode
                              and CFI.psch_schme_id = PPS.ppms_promotion_code
               inner join snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_offritem ofitm
                          on ofitm.porg_orgacode = cfi.porg_orgacode
                              and ofitm.pbet_busentity_type = cfi.pbet_busentity_type
                              and ofitm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = cfi.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
                              and ofitm.pdot_docmtype = cfi.pdot_docmtype
                              and ofitm.tcmm_docno = cfi.tcmm_docno
                              and ofitm.tcmo_offer_srno = cfi.tcmo_offer_srno
               left join snd_pr_bth_prod_batch bth
                          on CFI.porg_orgacode = bth.porg_orgacode
                              and ofitm.porp_princode = bth.porp_princode
                              and ofitm.pprd_prodcode = bth.pprd_prodcode
                              and ofitm.pbth_batch = bth.pbth_batch
      GROUP BY CFI.PORG_ORGACODE, CFI.TCMM_DOCNO, CFI.PDOT_DOCMTYPE, CFI.psch_schme_id, PPS.PPMS_DESC,
               CFI.tcmo_promotion_type, CFI.pbet_busentity_type, CFI.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
               CFI.MODIFIED_DATE) cmm

result.tbl:
(SELECT cmc.porg_orgacode,
        cmc.pbet_busentity_type,
        cmc.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
        cmc.pdot_docmtype,
        CMC.tcmm_docno,
        CMC.pchs_charges_code,
        SUM(CMC.tcmc_value)                                tcmc_value,
        concat(CMC.pchs_charges_code, ' - ', CS.pchs_desc) description,
        CS.pchs_desc,
        CS.pchs_charges_type,
        CMC.MODIFIED_DATE AS                               MODIFIED_DATE
 FROM snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_charges CMC
          INNER JOIN glb_pr_chs_charges_setup CS
                     ON CS.porg_orgacode = CMC.porg_orgacode AND CS.pchs_charges_code = CMC.pchs_charges_code
 GROUP BY cmc.porg_orgacode, cmc.pbet_busentity_type, cmc.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code, cmc.pdot_docmtype,
          CMC.tcmm_docno, CMC.pchs_charges_code, CS.pchs_desc, CS.pchs_charges_type,CMC.MODIFIED_DATE)

SND_EN_PJP_PJPHEAD PJP
         INNER JOIN SND_EN_OP1_OTH_BSEN_PHS_LVL1 PP1
                    ON PJP.PORG_ORGACODE = PP1.PORG_ORGACODE
                        AND PJP.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = PP1.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE
                        AND PJP.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE = PP1.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE
         INNER JOIN SND_EN_PP2_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL2 DSR
                         ON DSR.PORG_ORGACODE = PJP.PORG_ORGACODE_PHS_LVL2_F
                             AND DSR.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = PJP.PBET_BUSENT_TYPE_PHS_LVL2_F
                             AND DSR.EPP2_BUSENT_PHS_LVL2_CODE = PJP.EPP2_BUSENT_CODE_PHS_LVL2_F
         INNER join snd_pr_dst_dsrtype DSRTYPE
                         ON DSR.porg_orgacode = DSRTYPE.porg_orgacode
                         and DSR.pdst_dsr_type = DSRTYPE.pdst_dsr_type
         LEFT OUTER JOIN SND_EN_PP2_PRF_BSEN_PHS_LVL2_M DSRM
                         ON DSR.PORG_ORGACODE = DSRM.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND DSR.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = DSRM.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE
                             AND DSR.epp2_busent_phs_lvl2_code = DSRM.epp2_busent_phs_lvl2_code
                             AND DSRM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT OUTER JOIN GLB_PR_BNK_BANK BNK
                         ON BNK.PORG_ORGACODE = PJP.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND BNK.PBNK_BANK_CODE = PJP.PBNK_BANK_CODE
         LEFT OUTER JOIN GLB_PR_BNK_BANK_M BNKM
                         ON BNK.PORG_ORGACODE = BNKM.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND BNK.PBNK_BANK_CODE = BNKM.PBNK_BANK_CODE
                             AND BNKM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT OUTER JOIN GLB_PR_BNB_BANKBRANCH BNB
                         ON BNB.PORG_ORGACODE = PJP.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND BNB.PBNK_BANK_CODE = PJP.PBNK_BANK_CODE
                             AND BNB.PBNB_BNBR_CODE = PJP.PBNB_BNBR_CODE
         LEFT OUTER JOIN GLB_PR_BNB_BANKBRANCH_M BNBM
                         ON BNB.PORG_ORGACODE = BNBM.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND BNB.PBNK_BANK_CODE = BNBM.PBNK_BANK_CODE
                             AND BNB.PBNB_BNBR_CODE = BNBM.PBNB_BNBR_CODE
                             AND BNBM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT OUTER JOIN SND_EN_PJP_PJPHEAD_M PJPM
                         ON PJP.PORG_ORGACODE = PJPM.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND PJP.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = PJPM.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE
                             AND PJP.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE = PJPM.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE
                             AND PJP.EPJP_PJPNO = PJPM.EPJP_PJPNO
                             AND PJPM.PLNG_LANGCODE = '@Session(languageCode)'

SND_TR_CLD_CLAIM_DETAIL CD
inner join snd_tr_clm_claim_master clm on cd.porg_orgacode = clm.porg_orgacode and cd.pbet_busentity_type = clm.pbet_busentity_type and cd.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = clm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code and cd.pdot_docmtype = clm.pdot_docmtype and cd.tclm_docno = clm.tclm_docno
LEFT JOIN prm_pm_pms_promotion_setup PS ON
CD.porg_orgacode = PS.porg_orgacode
AND CD.psch_schme_id = PS.ppms_promotion_code
LEFT JOIN prm_pm_pms_promotion_setup_m PSM ON
PSM.porg_orgacode = PS.porg_orgacode
AND PSM.ppms_promotion_code = PS.ppms_promotion_code
AND PSM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)' LEFT JOIN GLB_PR_ORP_PRINCIPAL ORP
                   ON CD.porg_orgacode = ORP.porg_orgacode
                       AND CD.porp_princode = ORP.porp_princode
         LEFT JOIN GLB_PR_ORP_PRINCIPAL_M ORPM
                   ON CD.porg_orgacode = ORPM.porg_orgacode
                       AND CD.porp_princode = ORPM.porp_princode
                       AND ORPM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT JOIN SND_PR_PRD_PRODUCT PRD
                   ON CD.porg_orgacode = PRD.porg_orgacode
                       AND CD.porp_princode = PRD.porp_princode
                       AND CD.pprd_prodcode = PRD.pprd_prodcode
         LEFT JOIN SND_PR_PRD_PRODUCT_M PRDM
                   ON CD.porg_orgacode = PRDM.porg_orgacode
                       AND CD.porp_princode = PRDM.porp_princode
                       AND CD.pprd_prodcode = PRDM.pprd_prodcode
                       AND PRDM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)' LEFT JOIN SND_PR_STT_SKU_STOCKTYPE STT
ON CD.porg_orgacode = STT.porg_orgacode
AND CD.pstt_stock_type = STT.pstt_stock_type
LEFT JOIN SND_PR_STT_SKU_STOCKTYPE_M STTM
ON STTM.porg_orgacode = STT.porg_orgacode
AND STTM.pstt_stock_type = STT.pstt_stock_type
AND STTM.plng_langcode ='@Session(languageCode)'

(
    SELECT CLR.TCLR_RFSRNO                                                           AS TCLR_RFSRNO,
           CLR.porg_orgacode                                                         AS porg_orgacode,
           CLR.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE                                                   AS PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE,
           CLR.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code                                             AS epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
           coalesce(CLD.PSCH_SCHME_ID, tpiim.tinc_incentive)                         AS PSCH_SCHME_ID,
           ps.ppms_reference_code                AS REF_PROMO_CODE,
           coalesce(coalesce(PS.ppms_desc, PSM.ppms_desc), tpiim2.tinc_desc)         AS TXT__PromoDesc,
           CLR.tclr_refdoctype                                                       AS tclr_refdoctype,
           CLR.tclr_refdocno                                                         AS tclr_refdocno,
           coalesce(cmm.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c, hd.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c) AS epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c,
           coalesce(lvl1.epp1_desc, lvl1_h_m.epp1_desc)                              AS epp1_desc,
           CLR.TCLM_DOCNO                                                            AS TCLM_DOCNO,
           CLR.TCLD_SERIAL_NO                                                        AS TCLD_SERIAL_NO,
           CLM.modified_date                                                         AS modified_date,
           CLD.pdot_docmtype                                                         AS PDOT_DOCMTYPE,
           ROUND(SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN t.ptrn_nature = 'FRE' THEN
                                     CASE
                                         WHEN cmm.pdot_docmtype IN ('CM-04', 'CM-02') THEN -1
                                         ELSE 1
                                         END * COALESCE(ABS(i.tcmi_claim_amount_fcy), 0)
                             ELSE
                                 CASE
                                     WHEN dt.pdot_nature_identifier = 'RWD-CN-CLM'
                                         THEN COALESCE(ABS(hd.tfdh_total_adjusted_amt_bcy), 0)
                                     when CLD.pdot_docmtype in ('LS-01','DC') then COALESCE(CLD.tcld_grs_amt_fcy,0)
                                     ELSE COALESCE(-1 * (i.tcmi_dsc_amt_fcy), 0)

                                     END
                             END
                     ), 2)                                                           AS claimAmountFC

    FROM snd_tr_clm_claim_master CLM
             INNER JOIN snd_tr_cld_claim_detail CLD
                        ON CLD.porg_orgacode = CLM.porg_orgacode AND
                           CLD.pdot_docmtype = CLM.pdot_docmtype AND
                           CLD.pbet_busentity_type = CLM.pbet_busentity_type AND
                           CLD.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = CLM.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code AND
                           CLD.tclm_docno = CLM.tclm_docno
             INNER JOIN snd_tr_clr_claim_refinfo CLR
                        ON CLR.porg_orgacode = CLD.porg_orgacode AND
                           CLR.pdot_docmtype = CLD.pdot_docmtype AND
                           CLR.pbet_busentity_type = CLD.pbet_busentity_type AND
                           CLR.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = CLD.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code AND
                           CLR.tclm_docno = CLD.tclm_docno and CLR.tcld_serial_no = CLD.tcld_serial_no
             left outer JOIN snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_master cmm ON CLR.porg_orgacode = cmm.porg_orgacode and
                                                               CLR.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = cmm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code and
                                                               clr.pbet_busentity_type = cmm.pbet_busentity_type AND
                                                               CLR.tclr_refdocno = cmm.tcmm_docno and
                                                               CLR.tclr_refdoctype = cmm.pdot_docmtype

             inner join snd_pr_dot_documenttype dt
                        on CLM.PORG_ORGACODE = dt.PORG_ORGACODE and CLM.PDOT_DOCMTYPE = dt.PDOT_DOCMTYPE

             left outer join snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_offering o
                             on o.porg_orgacode = cmm.porg_orgacode
                                 and o.pbet_busentity_type = cmm.pbet_busentity_type
                                 and o.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = cmm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
                                 and o.pdot_docmtype = cmm.pdot_docmtype
                                 and o.tcmm_docno = cmm.tcmm_docno
                                 and coalesce(o.tcmo_claimable, 'N') = 'Y'
                                 and o.PSCH_SCHME_ID = CLD.PSCH_SCHME_ID

             left outer join snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_offritem i
                             on o.porg_orgacode = i.porg_orgacode
                                 and o.pbet_busentity_type = i.pbet_busentity_type
                                 and o.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = i.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
                                 and o.pdot_docmtype = i.pdot_docmtype
                                 and o.tcmm_docno = i.tcmm_docno
                                 and o.tcmo_offer_srno = i.tcmo_offer_srno
                                 and i.porp_princode = cld.porp_princode and i.pprd_prodcode = cld.pprd_prodcode

             left outer join snd_pr_trn_trans_nature t
                             on t.porg_orgacode = i.porg_orgacode
                                 and t.pdot_docmtype = i.pdot_docmtype
                                 and t.ptrn_tran_nature = i.ptrn_tran_nature
                                 and t.ptrn_nature in ('DIS', 'FRE')

             left outer JOIN snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1 lvl1
                             ON lvl1.porg_orgacode = cmm.porg_orgacode and
                                lvl1.porg_orgacode = cmm.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_c AND
                                lvl1.pbet_busentity_type = cmm.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_c and
                                lvl1.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = cmm.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c


             left outer JOIN glb_pr_bem_busentity_mistype MIS ON MIS.porg_orgacode = lvl1.porg_orgacode AND
                                                                 MIS.pbem_busentity_mistype = lvl1.pbem_busentity_mistype
             left outer JOIN prm_pm_pms_promotion_setup PS
                             ON CLD.porg_orgacode = PS.porg_orgacode AND
                                CLD.psch_schme_id = PS.ppms_promotion_code And
                                CLD.tcmo_promotion_type = PS.pprt_resultant_type

             left outer JOIN prm_pm_pms_promotion_setup_m PSM
                             ON PSM.porg_orgacode = PS.porg_orgacode AND
                                PSM.ppms_promotion_code = PS.ppms_promotion_code
                                 AND PSM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
             left join snd_tr_fdh_financial_doc_hdr hd on
            clr.porg_orgacode = hd.porg_orgacode
            and clr.pbet_busentity_type = hd.pbet_busentity_type
            and clr.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = hd.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
            and clr.tclr_refdoctype = hd.pdot_docmtype
            and clr.tclr_refdocno = hd.tfdh_docno

             left outer JOIN snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1_m lvl1_h_m
                             ON lvl1_h_m.porg_orgacode = hd.porg_orgacode and
                                lvl1_h_m.porg_orgacode = hd.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_c AND
                                lvl1_h_m.pbet_busentity_type = hd.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_c and
                                lvl1_h_m.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = hd.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c and
                                lvl1_h_m.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'

             left join tgt_pr_inr_incentive_reward tpiir
                       on tpiir.porg_orgacode = hd.porg_orgacode
                           and tpiir.pbet_busentity_type = hd.pbet_busentity_type
                           and tpiir.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = hd.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
                           and tpiir.pdot_docmtype = hd.pdot_docmtype
                           and tpiir.tfdh_docno = hd.tfdh_docno
             left join tgt_pr_inc_incentive tpii on tpii.porg_orgacode = tpiir.porg_orgacode
        and tpii.tinc_incentive = tpiir.tinc_incentive
             left join tgt_pr_inc_incentive_m tpiim
                       on tpiim.porg_orgacode = tpii.porg_orgacode
                           and tpiim.tinc_incentive = tpii.tinc_incentive
                           and tpiim.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
             left join tgt_pr_inc_incentive_m tpiim2
                       on
                               tpiim2.porg_orgacode = tpii.porg_orgacode
                               and tpiim2.tinc_incentive = tpii.tinc_incentive
                               and tpiim2.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'


    group by CLR.TCLR_RFSRNO, CLR.porg_orgacode, CLR.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE, CLR.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
             CLD.PSCH_SCHME_ID, PS.ppms_desc, PSM.ppms_desc, CLR.tclr_refdoctype, CLR.tclr_refdocno,
             cmm.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c, lvl1.epp1_desc, CLR.TCLM_DOCNO, CLR.TCLD_SERIAL_NO,
             CLM.modified_date, CLD.pdot_docmtype, hd.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c, lvl1_h_m.epp1_desc, tpiim2.tinc_desc,
             tpiim.tinc_incentive,ps.ppms_reference_code
)

         inner join snd_tr_clm_claim_master clm
                    on cd.porg_orgacode = clm.porg_orgacode and cd.pbet_busentity_type = clm.pbet_busentity_type and
                       cd.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = clm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code and
                       cd.pdot_docmtype = clm.pdot_docmtype and cd.tclm_docno = clm.tclm_docno
         LEFT JOIN prm_pm_pms_promotion_setup PS ON
        CD.porg_orgacode = PS.porg_orgacode
        AND CD.psch_schme_id = PS.ppms_promotion_code
         LEFT JOIN prm_pm_pms_promotion_setup_m PSM ON
        PSM.porg_orgacode = PS.porg_orgacode
        AND PSM.ppms_promotion_code = PS.ppms_promotion_code

(SELECT CLR.TCLR_RFSRNO                       AS TCLR_RFSRNO,
        CLR.porg_orgacode                     AS porg_orgacode,
        CLR.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE               AS PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE,
        CLR.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code         AS epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
        CLD.PSCH_SCHME_ID                     AS PSCH_SCHME_ID,
        ''                AS REF_PROMO_CODE,
        coalesce(PS.ppms_desc, PSM.ppms_desc) AS TXT__PromoDesc,
        CLR.tclr_refdoctype                   AS tclr_refdoctype,
        CLR.tclr_refdocno                     AS tclr_refdocno,
        cmm.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c       AS epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c,
        lvl1.epp1_desc                       AS epp1_desc,
        CLR.TCLM_DOCNO                        AS TCLM_DOCNO,
        CLR.TCLD_SERIAL_NO                    AS TCLD_SERIAL_NO,
        CLM.modified_date                     AS modified_date,
        CLD.pdot_docmtype                     AS PDOT_DOCMTYPE,

          CASE
                              WHEN CLR.tclr_refdoctype IN ('CM-04', 'CM-02') THEN -1
                              ELSE 1
                              END *
ABS(coalesce ((ROUND(SUM(

                          CASE
                              WHEN t.ptrn_nature = 'FRE' THEN COALESCE(ABS(i.tcmi_claim_amount_fcy), 0)
                              ELSE
                                      COALESCE((i.tcmi_dsc_amt_fcy), 0)

                              END
                  ), 2) * coalesce (NULLIF(o.tcmo_claimable_perc,0),1) / 100),0))                     AS claimAmountFC

FROM snd_tr_clm_claim_master CLM
          INNER JOIN snd_tr_cld_claim_detail CLD
                     ON CLD.porg_orgacode = CLM.porg_orgacode AND
                        CLD.pdot_docmtype = CLM.pdot_docmtype AND
                        CLD.pbet_busentity_type = CLM.pbet_busentity_type AND
                        CLD.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = CLM.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code AND
                        CLD.tclm_docno = CLM.tclm_docno
          INNER JOIN snd_tr_clr_claim_refinfo CLR
                     ON CLR.porg_orgacode = CLD.porg_orgacode AND
                        CLR.pdot_docmtype = CLD.pdot_docmtype AND
                        CLR.pbet_busentity_type = CLD.pbet_busentity_type AND
                        CLR.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = CLD.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code AND
                        CLR.tclm_docno = CLD.tclm_docno and CLR.tcld_serial_no = CLD.tcld_serial_no
          inner join snd_pr_dot_documenttype dt
                     on CLM.PORG_ORGACODE = dt.PORG_ORGACODE and CLM.PDOT_DOCMTYPE = dt.PDOT_DOCMTYPE
          left outer JOIN snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_master cmm ON CLR.porg_orgacode = cmm.porg_orgacode and
                                                            CLR.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = cmm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code and
                                                            clr.pbet_busentity_type = cmm.pbet_busentity_type AND
                                                            CLR.tclr_refdocno = cmm.tcmm_docno and
                                                            CLR.tclr_refdoctype = cmm.pdot_docmtype

          left outer join snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_offering o
                          on o.porg_orgacode = cmm.porg_orgacode
                              and o.pbet_busentity_type = cmm.pbet_busentity_type
                              and o.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = cmm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
                              and o.pdot_docmtype = cmm.pdot_docmtype
                              and o.tcmm_docno = cmm.tcmm_docno
                              and coalesce(o.tcmo_claimable, 'N') = 'Y'
                              and o.PSCH_SCHME_ID = CLD.PSCH_SCHME_ID

          left outer join snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_offritem i
                          on o.porg_orgacode = i.porg_orgacode
                              and o.pbet_busentity_type = i.pbet_busentity_type
                              and o.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = i.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
                              and o.pdot_docmtype = i.pdot_docmtype
                              and o.tcmm_docno = i.tcmm_docno
                              and o.tcmo_offer_srno = i.tcmo_offer_srno
          LEFT JOIN snd_pr_trn_trans_nature t
                    on t.porg_orgacode = i.porg_orgacode
                        and t.pdot_docmtype = i.pdot_docmtype
                        and t.ptrn_tran_nature = i.ptrn_tran_nature
                        and t.ptrn_nature in ('DIS', 'FRE')

          LEFT JOIN snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1 lvl1
                    ON lvl1.porg_orgacode = cmm.porg_orgacode and
                      lvl1.porg_orgacode = cmm.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_c AND
                       lvl1.pbet_busentity_type = cmm.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_c and
                       lvl1.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = cmm.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c
          LEFT JOIN glb_pr_bem_busentity_mistype MIS ON MIS.porg_orgacode = lvl1.porg_orgacode AND
                                                        MIS.pbem_busentity_mistype = lvl1.pbem_busentity_mistype
          LEFT JOIN prm_pm_pms_promotion_setup PS
                    ON CLD.porg_orgacode = PS.porg_orgacode AND
                       CLD.psch_schme_id = PS.ppms_promotion_code And
                       CLD.tcmo_promotion_type = PS.pprt_resultant_type
          LEFT JOIN prm_pm_pms_promotion_setup_m PSM
                    ON PSM.porg_orgacode = PS.porg_orgacode AND
                       PSM.ppms_promotion_code = PS.ppms_promotion_code
                        AND PSM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'

group by CLR.TCLR_RFSRNO, CLR.porg_orgacode, CLR.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE, CLR.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
          CLD.PSCH_SCHME_ID, PS.ppms_desc, PSM.ppms_desc, CLR.tclr_refdoctype, CLR.tclr_refdocno,
          cmm.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c, lvl1.epp1_desc, CLR.TCLM_DOCNO, CLR.TCLD_SERIAL_NO, CLM.modified_date,
          CLD.pdot_docmtype,o.tcmo_claimable_perc

)

result.tbl:
(SELECT CLR.TCLR_RFSRNO                       AS TCLR_RFSRNO,
        CLR.porg_orgacode                     AS porg_orgacode,
        CLR.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE               AS PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE,
        CLR.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code         AS epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
        CLD.PSCH_SCHME_ID                     AS PSCH_SCHME_ID,
        CLR.tclr_refdoctype                   AS tclr_refdoctype,
        CLR.tclr_refdocno                     AS tclr_refdocno,
        hd.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c       AS epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c,
        offinv.epp1_desc                       AS epp1_desc,
        CLR.TCLM_DOCNO                        AS TCLM_DOCNO,
        CLR.TCLD_SERIAL_NO                    AS TCLD_SERIAL_NO,
        CLM.modified_date                     AS modified_date,
        CLD.pdot_docmtype                     AS PDOT_DOCMTYPE,
		sum(coalesce(hd.tfdh_total_adjusted_amt_bcy, hd.tfdh_amount_fcy)) AS claimAmountFC

FROM snd_tr_clm_claim_master CLM
          INNER JOIN snd_tr_cld_claim_detail CLD
                     ON CLD.porg_orgacode = CLM.porg_orgacode AND
                        CLD.pdot_docmtype = CLM.pdot_docmtype AND
                        CLD.pbet_busentity_type = CLM.pbet_busentity_type AND
                        CLD.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = CLM.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code AND
                        CLD.tclm_docno = CLM.tclm_docno
          INNER JOIN snd_tr_clr_claim_refinfo CLR
                     ON CLR.porg_orgacode = CLD.porg_orgacode AND
                        CLR.pdot_docmtype = CLD.pdot_docmtype AND
                        CLR.pbet_busentity_type = CLD.pbet_busentity_type AND
                        CLR.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = CLD.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code AND
                        CLR.tclm_docno = CLD.tclm_docno and CLR.tcld_serial_no = CLD.tcld_serial_no
          inner join snd_pr_dot_documenttype dt
                     on CLM.PORG_ORGACODE = dt.PORG_ORGACODE and CLM.PDOT_DOCMTYPE = dt.PDOT_DOCMTYPE
          left join snd_tr_fdh_financial_doc_hdr hd on
         clr.porg_orgacode = hd.porg_orgacode
         and clr.pbet_busentity_type = hd.pbet_busentity_type
         and clr.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = hd.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
         and clr.tclr_refdoctype = hd.pdot_docmtype
         and clr.tclr_refdocno = hd.tfdh_docno
          LEFT JOIN snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1 offinv
                    ON offinv.porg_orgacode = hd.porg_orgacode and
                      offinv.porg_orgacode = hd.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_c AND
                       offinv.pbet_busentity_type = hd.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_c and
                       offinv.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = hd.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c

group by CLR.TCLR_RFSRNO, CLR.porg_orgacode, CLR.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE, CLR.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
          CLD.PSCH_SCHME_ID, CLR.tclr_refdoctype, CLR.tclr_refdocno,
          CLR.TCLM_DOCNO, CLR.TCLD_SERIAL_NO, CLM.modified_date,
          CLD.pdot_docmtype
          ,hd.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c,offinv.epp1_desc
)

result.tbl:
SND_TR_CLM_CLAIM_MASTER CLM
         LEFT JOIN SND_PR_DOS_DOCUMENTSTATUS SPDD
                   ON CLM.PORG_ORGACODE = SPDD.PORG_ORGACODE
                       AND CLM.PDOT_DOCMTYPE = SPDD.PDOT_DOCMTYPE
                       AND CLM.PDOS_DOCMSTATUS = SPDD.PDOS_DOCMSTATUS
         LEFT JOIN SND_PR_DOS_DOCUMENTSTATUS_M SPDDM
                   ON SPDD.PORG_ORGACODE = SPDDM.PORG_ORGACODE
                       AND SPDD.PDOT_DOCMTYPE = SPDDM.PDOT_DOCMTYPE
                       AND SPDD.PDOS_DOCMSTATUS = SPDDM.PDOS_DOCMSTATUS
                       AND SPDDM.PLNG_LANGCODE = '@Session(languageCode)'
         INNER JOIN SND_TR_CLR_CLAIM_REFINFO CLR
                    ON CLR.PORG_ORGACODE = CLM.PORG_ORGACODE AND
                       CLR.PDOT_DOCMTYPE = CLM.PDOT_DOCMTYPE AND
                       CLR.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = CLM.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE AND
                       CLR.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE = CLM.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE AND
                       CLR.TCLM_DOCNO = CLM.TCLM_DOCNO
         LEFT OUTER JOIN SND_TR_STM_STOCK_MASTER STM
                         ON STM.PORG_ORGACODE = CLR.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND STM.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE = CLR.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE
                             AND STM.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE = CLR.EPP1_BUSENT_PHS_LVL1_CODE
                             AND STM.PDOT_DOCMTYPE = CLR.TCLR_REFDOCTYPE
                             AND STM.TSTM_DOCNO = CLR.TCLR_REFDOCNO

result.tbl:
SND_TR_CLD_CLAIM_DETAIL CD
         inner join snd_tr_clm_claim_master clm
                    on cd.porg_orgacode = clm.porg_orgacode and cd.pbet_busentity_type = clm.pbet_busentity_type and
                       cd.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = clm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code and
                       cd.pdot_docmtype = clm.pdot_docmtype and cd.tclm_docno = clm.tclm_docno
         LEFT JOIN GLB_PR_ORP_PRINCIPAL ORP
                   ON CD.porg_orgacode = ORP.porg_orgacode
                       AND CD.porp_princode = ORP.porp_princode
         LEFT JOIN GLB_PR_ORP_PRINCIPAL_M ORPM
                   ON CD.porg_orgacode = ORPM.porg_orgacode
                       AND CD.porp_princode = ORPM.porp_princode
                       AND ORPM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT JOIN SND_PR_PRD_PRODUCT PRD
                   ON CD.porg_orgacode = PRD.porg_orgacode
                       AND CD.porp_princode = PRD.porp_princode
                       AND CD.pprd_prodcode = PRD.pprd_prodcode
         LEFT JOIN SND_PR_PRD_PRODUCT_M PRDM
                   ON CD.porg_orgacode = PRDM.porg_orgacode
                       AND CD.porp_princode = PRDM.porp_princode
                       AND CD.pprd_prodcode = PRDM.pprd_prodcode
                       AND PRDM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT JOIN SND_PR_STT_SKU_STOCKTYPE STT
                   ON CD.porg_orgacode = STT.porg_orgacode
                       AND CD.pstt_stock_type = STT.pstt_stock_type
         LEFT JOIN SND_PR_STT_SKU_STOCKTYPE_M STTM
                   ON STTM.porg_orgacode = STT.porg_orgacode
                       AND STTM.pstt_stock_type = STT.pstt_stock_type
                       AND STTM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'
         LEFT JOIN GLB_PR_RNT_REASON_TYPE RNT
                   ON RNT.PORG_ORGACODE = cd.PORG_ORGACODE
                       AND RNT.PRNT_REASON_TYPE = cd.tcld_project_code
         LEFT JOIN GLB_PR_RNT_REASON_TYPE_M RNTM
                   ON RNT.PORG_ORGACODE = RNTM.PORG_ORGACODE
                       AND RNT.PRNT_REASON_TYPE = RNTM.PRNT_REASON_TYPE
                       AND RNTM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'

result.tbl:
(
    SELECT CLR.TCLR_RFSRNO               AS TCLR_RFSRNO,
           CLR.porg_orgacode             AS porg_orgacode,
           CLR.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE       AS PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE,
           CLR.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code AS epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
           CLR.tclr_refdoctype           AS tclr_refdoctype,
           CLR.tclr_refdocno             AS tclr_refdocno,
           CLR.TCLM_DOCNO                AS TCLM_DOCNO,
           CLR.TCLD_SERIAL_NO            AS TCLD_SERIAL_NO,
           CLM.modified_date             AS modified_date,
           CLD.pdot_docmtype             AS PDOT_DOCMTYPE

    FROM snd_tr_clm_claim_master CLM
             INNER JOIN snd_tr_cld_claim_detail CLD
                        ON CLD.porg_orgacode = CLM.porg_orgacode AND
                           CLD.pdot_docmtype = CLM.pdot_docmtype AND
                           CLD.pbet_busentity_type = CLM.pbet_busentity_type AND
                           CLD.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = CLM.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code AND
                           CLD.tclm_docno = CLM.tclm_docno
             INNER JOIN snd_tr_clr_claim_refinfo CLR
                        ON CLR.porg_orgacode = CLD.porg_orgacode AND
                           CLR.pdot_docmtype = CLD.pdot_docmtype AND
                           CLR.pbet_busentity_type = CLD.pbet_busentity_type AND
                           CLR.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = CLD.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code AND
                           CLR.tclm_docno = CLD.tclm_docno and CLR.tcld_serial_no = CLD.tcld_serial_no
             inner join snd_tr_stm_stock_master SM on
            SM.porg_orgacode = CLR.porg_orgacode and SM.pbet_busentity_type = CLR.pbet_busentity_type and
            SM.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = CLR.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code and SM.pdot_docmtype = CLR.tclr_refdoctype and
            SM.tstm_docno = CLR.tclr_refdocno

             inner join snd_pr_dot_documenttype dt
                        on CLM.PORG_ORGACODE = dt.PORG_ORGACODE and CLM.PDOT_DOCMTYPE = dt.PDOT_DOCMTYPE


    group by CLR.TCLR_RFSRNO, CLR.porg_orgacode, CLR.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE, CLR.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
             CLD.PSCH_SCHME_ID, CLR.tclr_refdoctype, CLR.tclr_refdocno,
             CLR.TCLM_DOCNO, CLR.TCLD_SERIAL_NO,
             CLM.modified_date, CLD.pdot_docmtype
)
AA

and spdd.pdos_docmstatus = spddm.pdos_docmstatus

result.tbl:
(
    SELECT CLR.TCLR_RFSRNO                                       AS TCLR_RFSRNO,
           CLR.porg_orgacode                                     AS porg_orgacode,
           CLR.TCLM_DOCNO                                        AS TCLM_DOCNO,
           CLD.pdot_docmtype                                     AS PDOT_DOCMTYPE,
           CLR.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE                               AS PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE,
           CLR.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code                         AS epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
           tpiim.tinc_incentive                                  AS PSCH_SCHME_ID,
           tpiim.tinc_desc                                       AS TXT__PromoDesc,
           CLR.tclr_refdoctype                                   AS tclr_refdoctype,
           CLR.tclr_refdocno                                     AS tclr_refdocno,

           lvl1_h_m.epp1_desc                                    AS epp1_desc,
           CLR.TCLD_SERIAL_NO                                    AS TCLD_SERIAL_NO,
           CLM.modified_date                                     AS modified_date,
           hd.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c,

           COALESCE(SUM(ABS(hd.TFDH_AMOUNT_FCY)), 0) as claimAmountFC

    FROM snd_tr_clm_claim_master CLM
             INNER JOIN snd_tr_cld_claim_detail CLD
                        ON CLD.porg_orgacode = CLM.porg_orgacode AND
                           CLD.pdot_docmtype = CLM.pdot_docmtype AND
                           CLD.pbet_busentity_type = CLM.pbet_busentity_type AND
                           CLD.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = CLM.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code AND
                           CLD.tclm_docno = CLM.tclm_docno
             INNER JOIN snd_tr_clr_claim_refinfo CLR
                        ON CLR.porg_orgacode = CLD.porg_orgacode AND
                           CLR.pdot_docmtype = CLD.pdot_docmtype AND
                           CLR.pbet_busentity_type = CLD.pbet_busentity_type AND
                           CLR.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = CLD.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code AND
                           CLR.tclm_docno = CLD.tclm_docno and CLR.tcld_serial_no = CLD.tcld_serial_no


             inner join snd_pr_dot_documenttype dt
                        on CLM.PORG_ORGACODE = dt.PORG_ORGACODE and CLM.PDOT_DOCMTYPE = dt.PDOT_DOCMTYPE

             left join snd_tr_fdh_financial_doc_hdr hd on
            clr.porg_orgacode = hd.porg_orgacode
            and clr.pbet_busentity_type = hd.pbet_busentity_type
            and clr.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = hd.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
            and clr.tclr_refdoctype = hd.pdot_docmtype
            and clr.tclr_refdocno = hd.tfdh_docno

             left outer JOIN snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1_m lvl1_h_m
                             ON lvl1_h_m.porg_orgacode = hd.porg_orgacode and
                                lvl1_h_m.porg_orgacode = hd.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_c AND
                                lvl1_h_m.pbet_busentity_type = hd.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_c and
                                lvl1_h_m.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = hd.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c and
                                lvl1_h_m.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'

             left join tgt_pr_inr_incentive_reward tpiir
                       on tpiir.porg_orgacode = hd.porg_orgacode
                           and tpiir.pbet_busentity_type = hd.pbet_busentity_type
                           and tpiir.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = hd.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code
                           and tpiir.pdot_docmtype = hd.pdot_docmtype
                           and tpiir.tfdh_docno = hd.tfdh_docno
             left join tgt_pr_inc_incentive tpii on tpii.porg_orgacode = tpiir.porg_orgacode
        and tpii.tinc_incentive = tpiir.tinc_incentive
             left join tgt_pr_inc_incentive_m tpiim
                       on tpiim.porg_orgacode = tpii.porg_orgacode
                           and tpiim.tinc_incentive = tpii.tinc_incentive
                           and tpiim.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)'


    group by CLR.TCLR_RFSRNO, CLR.porg_orgacode, CLR.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE, CLR.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
             CLD.PSCH_SCHME_ID, CLR.tclr_refdoctype, CLR.tclr_refdocno,
             CLR.TCLM_DOCNO, CLR.TCLD_SERIAL_NO,
             CLM.modified_date, CLD.pdot_docmtype, hd.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c, lvl1_h_m.epp1_desc, tpiim.tinc_desc,
             tpiim.tinc_incentive
)

SND_TR_CLM_CLAIM_MASTER CLM
inner join snd_en_iom_io_master im on im.porg_orgacode =clm.porg_orgacode and im.eiom_io_number=clm.tclm_project_code
         LEFT JOIN SND_PR_DOT_DOCUMENTTYPE DOT
                         ON CLM.PORG_ORGACODE = DOT.PORG_ORGACODE
                        AND CLM.PDOT_DOCMTYPE = DOT.PDOT_DOCMTYPE
         LEFT OUTER JOIN SND_PR_DOS_DOCUMENTSTATUS DOS
                         ON CLM.PORG_ORGACODE = DOS.PORG_ORGACODE
                             AND CLM.PDOT_DOCMTYPE = DOS.PDOT_DOCMTYPE
                             AND CLM.PDOS_DOCMSTATUS = DOS.PDOS_DOCMSTATUS
                             LEFT JOIN SND_PR_DOS_DOCUMENTSTATUS_M SPDDM
ON DOS.PORG_ORGACODE = SPDDM.PORG_ORGACODE
AND DOS.PDOT_DOCMTYPE = SPDDM.PDOT_DOCMTYPE
AND DOS.PDOS_DOCMSTATUS = SPDDM.PDOS_DOCMSTATUS
and SPDDM.PLNG_LANGCODE = '@Session(languageCode)'

(SELECT CLR.TCLR_RFSRNO                            AS TCLR_RFSRNO,
             CLR.porg_orgacode                     AS porg_orgacode,
             CLR.PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE               AS PBET_BUSENTITY_TYPE,
             CLR.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code         AS epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code,
             CLD.PSCH_SCHME_ID                     AS PSCH_SCHME_ID,
             ps.ppms_reference_code                AS REF_PROMO_CODE,
             coalesce(PS.ppms_desc, PSM.ppms_desc) AS TXT__PromoDesc,
             CLR.tclr_refdoctype                   AS tclr_refdoctype,
             CLR.tclr_refdocno                     AS tclr_refdocno,
             cmm.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c       AS epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c,
             lvl1.epp1_desc                        AS epp1_desc,
             CLR.TCLM_DOCNO                        AS TCLM_DOCNO,
             CLR.TCLD_SERIAL_NO                    AS TCLD_SERIAL_NO,
             CLM.modified_date                     AS modified_date,
             CLD.pdot_docmtype                     AS PDOT_DOCMTYPE,
             CLR.tclr_gross_amt_fcy                AS claimAmountFC
      FROM snd_tr_clm_claim_master CLM
               INNER JOIN snd_tr_cld_claim_detail CLD
                          ON CLD.porg_orgacode = CLM.porg_orgacode AND
                             CLD.pdot_docmtype = CLM.pdot_docmtype AND
                             CLD.pbet_busentity_type = CLM.pbet_busentity_type AND
                             CLD.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = CLM.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code AND
                             CLD.tclm_docno = CLM.tclm_docno
               INNER JOIN snd_tr_clr_claim_refinfo CLR
                          ON CLR.porg_orgacode = CLD.porg_orgacode AND
                             CLR.pdot_docmtype = CLD.pdot_docmtype AND
                             CLR.pbet_busentity_type = CLD.pbet_busentity_type AND
                             CLR.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = CLD.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code AND
                             CLR.tclm_docno = CLD.tclm_docno and CLR.tcld_serial_no = CLD.tcld_serial_no
               inner JOIN snd_tr_cmm_cashmemo_master cmm ON CLR.porg_orgacode = cmm.porg_orgacode and
                                                            CLR.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = cmm.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code and
                                                            clr.pbet_busentity_type = cmm.pbet_busentity_type AND
                                                            CLR.tclr_refdocno = cmm.tcmm_docno and
                                                            CLR.tclr_refdoctype = cmm.pdot_docmtype
               inner JOIN snd_en_pp1_prf_bsen_phs_lvl1 lvl1
                          ON lvl1.porg_orgacode = cmm.porg_orgacode and
                             lvl1.porg_orgacode = cmm.porg_orgacode_phs_lvl1_c AND
                             lvl1.pbet_busentity_type = cmm.pbet_busent_type_phs_lvl1_c and
                             lvl1.epp1_busent_phs_lvl1_code = cmm.epp1_busent_code_phs_lvl1_c
               inner JOIN prm_pm_pms_promotion_setup PS
                          ON CLD.porg_orgacode = PS.porg_orgacode AND
                             CLD.psch_schme_id = PS.ppms_promotion_code And
                             CLD.tcmo_promotion_type = PS.pprt_resultant_type
               LEFT JOIN prm_pm_pms_promotion_setup_m PSM
                         ON PSM.porg_orgacode = PS.porg_orgacode AND
                            PSM.ppms_promotion_code = PS.ppms_promotion_code
                             AND PSM.plng_langcode = '@Session(languageCode)') AA
